svg.title: Ceduljica · eight desktop paper-plaza screens
svg.desc: Eight native 1440 by 900 desktop compositions: entry, five-step how-to, owner lobby, private writing, ready, late-join and reconnect, one-note reveal, twelve-note reveal and delete confirmation. Original Ceduljica scenery and perimeter characters frame authored opaque vector UI. Accessibility and reduced-motion notes are visible below the screens.

svg.text: 1440 × 900 each · original sunny plaza family · authored UI

g.text: Bring everyone's idea to the same board.
A private room. One note each. One shared reveal.
You'll be the owner and write too.
How to use is available before entering a room.
Nickname is not a credential. Errors use a labelled summary and move keyboard focus there.
Dialog: trap focus · Escape closes · restore focus to How to use.
2 of 12 people · minimum met: 2 eligible people
Invite one more person to begin.
Guest view: “Waiting for the owner to begin.” Remove is owner-only; accessible name includes the guest.
Only you can see your note before reveal.
Let's make Friday lunch a picnic in the courtyard.
One multiline note · Enter inserts a new line · 500 / 500 — limit reached · never reveal others' draft bodies.
Waiting for 2 more. You can edit until reveal starts.
Let's make Friday lunch a picnic
If final readiness wins, the server-confirmed Reveal replaces this view. No animation delays the transition.
06 / Late join, reconnect grace and ownership
Watch this round finish. No note is needed from you yet.
No editor. No other people's note bodies.
Unfinished work is removed after grace.
Ready notes stay eligible. You are in the next round.
Ownership update: “Maya is now the owner.” New owner: “You are now the owner.”
Local banner: “Connection lost — trying again.” On return: “Back online. Room status updated.”
1 note · everyone sees the same board
Guest: “Waiting for owner.” Muted is a persistent pressed toggle; sound never carries state alone.
08 / Reveal · all 12 notes and delete confirmation
Stable order · 4 columns · note text never shrinks to fit
Dialog shown beside board for inspection.
Real dialog overlays an inert board. Trap focus; focus Keep room first; cancel returns to Delete room.
44 px targets minimum · 200% zoom / 320 px reflow · phase heading receives focus · polite status and ownership updates · deletion/removal assertive
Canvas motif: 48 s drift, hidden-page pause. Reduced motion: identical static ground, zero tilt/stagger, instant state feedback. Art is aria-hidden; no countdown announcements every second.
